pagerbot: ALERT: High 401 rate detected (alert_id=INF-ABC123) from inference-proxy-2 us-west-2 — suspected credential reuse. auto-paging to sam_oncall :rotating_light:

sam_oncall: ack — taking this. pulling logs now.

mike_infra: seeing ~3.1k 401/min from 10.0.5.0/24 to /v1/generate. suspect svcacct=inference-proxy-service-prod. seeing failed S3 PUT attempts right after 401 spikes.

kat_security: pinging legal/privacy. any signs of data exfil yet?

mike_infra: sample log:
```
2026-03-19T22:14:02Z inference-proxy-2 svc=inference-proxy-service-prod method=POST path=/v1/generate status=401 src=10.0.5.42 user_agent="curl/7.79" token_id=AKIA*** truncated
2026-03-19T22:14:03Z s3-uploader svc=inference-proxy-service-prod op=PutObject key="tmp/obj-1.part" err=403
```

eng-sre: linking runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/credential-reuse

sam_oncall: executing rotation plan — step 1: revoke current access key for svcacct; step 2: deploy short-lived IAM role; step 3: update proxies. command (pseudo): `scripts/rotate-keys.sh inference-proxy-service-prod` — starting now.

ops_anna: customer impact check: currently 0 users reporting errors; traffic is failing with 401s, so likely no plaintext leaks. tagging as potential incident for monitoring only. :eyes:

kat_security: recommend immediate denylist of suspicious CIDR 10.0.5.0/32 and enable honeypot sink for further probes. enable verbose audit logging for S3 writes and capture any PutObject attempts.

legal_bot: on-call legal team notified. please preserve logs and timeline. request: timeline within 2h and list of any affected customer ids.

sam_oncall: rotation complete. new keys rolled, proxies restarted, error rate down from ~3.1k/min to ~40/min. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre: creating PD incident PD-789234 and linking this thread. monitoring for 60m, will escalate if rebound.

sam_oncall: handing off monitoring to eng-sre and mike_infra. I'll draft postmortem and work with kat_security + legal. good catch team. :clap:
